site_name: Victoria and Albert Museum, Cromwell Road, LONDON
description: Alterations to level 4 of the Henry Cole Wing and the new Exhibition Road Quarter building on basement level B3 including strip-out of existing floor finishes, redundant M&E fixtures/containment and windows; new opening in wall and builders work holes; refurbishment of existing walls, ceilings, doors and second fix and redecoration throughout; new floor finishes throughout; new partitions to form new rooms; renovated room entrance doors and replacement internal windows; new automated blackout roller blinds to existing window in the Photo Studio; new access doors to existing internal windows above entrance doors; replacement lighting throughout and new Mechanical Ventilation.
